top_signal.title: How are you guys handling sales coaching without spending hours reviewing what your reps are doing?
top_signal.summary: I've been thinking a lot about how much sales performance comes down to what happens during conversations with customers rather than just the numbers we see at the end of the month. You can track leads and close rates all day but that doesn't tell you why one rep is closing more deals than another. Maybe one person is great at building trust but struggles with objections. Another might know the product inside out but rush through conversations and miss chances to close. The problem is that most managers don't have time to review every sales conversation and give each person feedback. And the usual weekly meetings don't help much when you're just looking at numbers and trying to remember what went wrong.   I've been looking into ways to make this process easier with some kind of sales coaching software. Ideally I'd want something that can record and analyze customer conversations and show where reps are doing well or missing opportunities. It would be useful if it could give each rep feedback based on our actual sales process rather than just generic sales tips. I'd also want managers to be able to review specific parts of conversations and leave feedback without having to listen to the whole thing. Being able to track how reps improve over time would be a big plus. Especially if you could see whether changes in how they handle objections or ask questions are making a difference in their close rates.   My main concern is getting people to use it.
